resources.string: Games and chat apps on the PC hear this device\'s microphone, when the host takes one
Microphone access was not allowed, so the microphone stays off. Allow it in Android settings to talk through the PC.
Keeps game sound from the speaker out of the microphone. Automatic turns it on with the speaker and off with headphones and Bluetooth headsets, and follows a switch during the stream.
Filters steady background noise, such as a fan, out of the microphone
Lets the device even out quiet and loud speech. The microphone gain below applies on top.
Makes the microphone quieter or louder before it is sent. Loud peaks are rounded off instead of clipping.
Shows a button on the stream that mutes and unmutes the microphone. Drag it to move it.
Not on this device: %1$s. The microphone is sent without this processing.
The microphone stopped working, so it is muted now. Unmute it to try again.
